question: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
clarification: Do not include the value '2012' itself.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) > '2012'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) >= '2012'

b.request: Count transactions at gas stations with Country = 'CZE' whose transaction date is in 2013 or later.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date >= '2013-01-01';
b.raw: Count transactions at gas stations with Country = 'CZE' whose transaction date is in 2013 or later.

c.request:
Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
Evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
Do not include the value '2012' itself.
c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND CAST(SUBSTR(t.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 2012;

d.request: How many transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic occurred after 2012, excluding all transactions from 2012?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'Czech Republic' AND t.Date >= '2013-01-01';
